paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.98% on average, with DAX strongest (+2.07%) and Nasdaq weakest (-0.62%). Brent crude changed -3.61% to 91.19. Gold changed +1.77% to 3,598.3. Bitcoin changed +0.75% to 60,832.6211. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.848%, a relative move of -1.14%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (+4.70%) and Glencore (+3.74%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Altria explores takeover bid for Imperial Brands (FT World). Takeover would see another of the UK’s large listed companies leave London market Deals and capital markets: NBA rallies private equity for €10bn European arena fund (FT Markets). Basketball league wants to help teams finance new arenas as part of its effort to launch a European competition Central banks and macro: UK inflation may peak at lower rate than BoE forecast, says governor (FT World). But Andrew Bailey refuses to rule out another interest rate increase next month Central banks and macro: Beige Book confirms hot US economy and signs of wage pressure building (FT World). The report will help cement the coming December Federal Reserve interest rate rise Geopolitics and trade: Opec+’s largest members head for clash over oil production estimates (FT Markets).
